name: Mundo Oscuro
english_description: A Spanish-language MudOS v21-era mudlib by Cain@MundoOscuro (2016 GitHub snapshot of a mid-2000s Spanish MUD), with a Lima-derived error handler and a D&D-flavored character system (race + class, six attributes, feats/skills). New characters register through a Spanish menu (nick, password, email, varón/hembra, race, class) and land at Entrada a los Reinos, which opens onto Torre del destino: Gran Salón — a marble creation-hall with exits to the immortal rank/group/channel rooms. Accounts, ranks, and channels are MySQL-backed (initd shuts the mud down if the database is missing), so browser WASM play cannot complete registration. Native play is fully verified. A large unfinished Underdark city (Zorimeth, ~290 rooms) sits under dominios/suboscuridad/.
